title: Hartley Plumbing & Heating | Emergency Plumber in Wirral
desc: Gas Safe registered plumber and heating engineer covering Wirral and Chester. Emergency callouts, boiler repairs, installations. No callout fee.
eyebrow: Gas Safe registered · No callout fee
h1: Burst pipe? We answer the phone.
sub: Emergency plumbing and heating across Wirral and Chester. Most jobs fixed same day, fixed price agreed before we start, and a real person on the end of the line at 2am.
svc_h: Plumbing and heating, priced before we start.
svc_l: No callout fee, no hourly meter running. We look at the job, quote a fixed price, and that is what you pay.

services.title: Emergency callouts
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, no heating, no hot water. We aim to be with you within the hour, day or night.

services.title: Boiler repair & servicing
services.desc: Gas Safe repairs on all major brands, plus annual services and landlord safety certificates.

services.title: Boiler installation
services.desc: New combi and system boilers supplied and fitted, with up to 10 years manufacturer warranty.

services.title: Bathroom installation
services.desc: Full bathroom fits, from a straight swap to strip-out and redesign. Tiling and electrics handled.

services.title: Leaks & drainage
services.desc: Leak detection, blocked drains, overflow and soil pipe work. We find it before we tear anything out.

services.title: Landlord certificates
services.desc: CP12 gas safety certificates for landlords and letting agents. Same-week appointments.

about_h: Twenty-two years under sinks across the Wirral.
about_p: Hartley Plumbing is Dean Hartley and two engineers — not a call centre that subcontracts your job to whoever is nearest. We are Gas Safe registered, fully insured, and we price the work before we pick up a spanner. If we cannot fix it today, we will tell you straight and book you in for when we can.

reviews.quote: Came out at half eleven at night when our heating packed in with a newborn in the house. Fixed it in forty minutes and charged exactly what he quoted on the phone.
reviews.name: Claire Dawson

reviews.quote: Had three quotes for a new combi. Dean was not the cheapest but he was the only one who actually explained why the others were wrong. Two years on, faultless.
reviews.name: Martin Rowe

reviews.quote: Full bathroom rip out and refit in six days. Tidy, on time, and they hoovered up every night before leaving. Cannot fault them.
reviews.name: Priya Shah

faq.q: Do you charge a callout fee?
faq.a: No. We quote a fixed price for the job before we start, and that is what you pay. If you decide not to go ahead, you owe us nothing.

faq.q: How fast can you get to an emergency?
faq.a: For genuine emergencies in the Wirral area we aim to be with you inside an hour, 24 hours a day. Ring us rather than using the form and you will speak to an engineer.
Yes, and we will show you the card before we touch anything gas. Never let anyone work on your gas appliances without it.
